dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave curve on the trailing edge, originating from the posterior insertion and terminating at the rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological peak with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Angular steepness of approximately 45 degrees relative to the longitudinal axis of the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base width is approximately 1.15 times the vertical height from the base to the apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a consistent radius defining the anterior-dorsal boundary of the head.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust rostrum with a width-to-length ratio of roughly 1:1.2.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse inflection point where the descending slope of the melon meets the dorsal surface of the rostrum.
